sloka: यदि मां तारयेदार्यः सुग्रीवः सत्यसङ्गरः ।अस्माद्दुःखाम्बुसंरोधाच्छीतो भव हनूमतः ।। 5.53.31।।।।
transliteration: yadi māṁ tārayedāryaḥ sugrīvaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ।asmādduḥkhāmbusaṁrodhācchīto bhava hanūmataḥ ।। 5.53.31।।।।

translations.english: "If Sugriva is true to his promise to fight (for me), if he should be able to rescue me from this ocean of agony let Hanuman be cool (not consumed by fire.)"
